emails.subject: Hidden phone number
body: Hey Callum,
I was looking at your website and noticed something on the homepage, on mobile, the phone number is hidden inside the menu.
Someone with a leaking roof has to dig through a menu to find how to call. Most of them won’t. They tap the next roofer on Google instead.
For a business like Kestrel & Pike Roofing, this is worth a quick look, should take about 5 minutes to review.
The fastest ROI is to add a tap-to-call button to the top of every page.
Happy to walk you through, no strings attached.
P. Iliev
